Introduction
 We are seeking a skilled Full Stack .NET Developer to join our high-performing agile team and contribute to the development and maintenance of a custom-built web application. The tech stack includes React, ASP.NET Core (.NET 9), and Azure SQL, ensuring top-quality software delivery.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
Technical solution design, build, test and implementation of new business requirements
Modify software products after delivery to correct faults, to improve performance or other attributes including related troubleshooting
Enhancing the overall user experience (e.g., in terms of usability, performance, security);
Modernizing the application architecture or underlying components;
Reducing technical debt and/or introducing incremental changes to the IT architecture (e.g., by refactoring existing components using established patterns);
Leveraging on existing event driven architecture capabilities to fulfill or enhance a specific business need (e.g., Kafka);
Enhancing the integration with other systems.
Enhancing the integration and data flows within the ecosystem.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Backend: C# and ASP.NET Core (currently .NET 9), containerized, hosted on Linux in Azure (AKS)
Frontend: React v16.14.0 (Redux/Flux), Typescript ,CSS: Sass/Less
Database and others: Azure SQL, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)/PowerBI , SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
Source control, CI/CD: Gitlab, Sonarqube
Key areas: Performance, Backend refactoring and architecture modernization
Advanced command of English, both orally and in writing (C1); preferably also language proficiency in Romanian
6+ years of working experience with .Net and SQL Server

Experience with React would be a plus
Good communication skills, collaborative work
Professional experience following agile processes such as Scrum
